comment: wb-agwj roster (R694 PREP F1 on the wb-e3eh gate cmd_ed834748f060, terminal enumerate-the-resolvable form bound by the owner ruling on wb-e3eh F7): the OUT-OF-FILE anchor of the wb-agwj section of test/workbench-claude-message-ref.test.ts. probeSource names the gate's LEG-2 probe file, committed byte for byte with its sha256; f1Escapes are the gate's 39 exploratory probes in its probe order, every one read quiet by E3EH_STRICT at S1 and S2; groups are the PREP's families (a)-(k) and the named bound's call-value family (cv); residuals resolve each F1 form as a named quiet residual of its family; channel is the one named residual of the spelling-generation channel with its runtime reading; twins are the F5 rider twins. Each row carries the placement digest the census recomputes.

channel.family: the spelling-generation channel: any spelling of a prototype or snapshot write outside the resolved set; this row places one at each pin, a rest binding read through a string index (P5) and the P4 sibling of GE5-ELEMENT-AT (P4), neither a probe of the gate's battery
channel.runtime: unobserved: the census parses the observer sites and never runs them, so a write spelled through the channel would execute with no census signal
